jpg_encode_rgb: encode an RGB image array to a JPEG-compressed byte buffer using OpenCV
jpg_decode_rgb: decode a JPEG-compressed byte buffer back into an RGB image array using OpenCV
blosc_encode_depth: compress a depth array into a Blosc-packed byte buffer using the zstd codec
blosc_decode_depth: decompress a Blosc-packed byte buffer back into the original depth array
summarize_data_compression: summarize the data_compression module functions for JPEG image encoding/decoding and Blosc depth array compression
